The summary and narration are source-supported and within the word limit. The characterization “The people addressed” is somewhat broad: the verse says the proclamation went among “all the people,” but does not specify individual recipients or show anyone present. The visual inference is appropriately tentative; avoid depicting people already gathering.

The summary says people march to the appointed gathering area, consistent with verse 22; “appointed place” should not be taken to mean one precisely localized spot, since verse 23 names a broad region.

The reasonable visual inference of a procession is supported, but depicting all listed animals and supplies together is a visual interpretation of the collective account, not a detailed scene specified by the verses. The preceding scene does not create a chronology conflict.
